cyclodextrins can be applied to enhance the drug dissolution and permeation through HPMC gels, and that the effect depends on the type of cyclodextrine and the type of formulation.
cyclodextrins can improve drug dissolution and diffusion from topical drug formulations.

the presence of CDs in the gel formulation did not significantly affect the permeation properties of piroxicam.
the use of cyclodextrines as a carrier of the drug in topical formulations is not a good solution.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of cyclodextrinic systems for topical formulations can improve drug dissolution properties, but the influence on drug permeability through the polymer matrix is not significant.
cyclodextrin inclusion complexes are promising candidates for topical drug delivery systems, especially for poorly soluble drugs.
the cyclodextrin inclusion complexes are promising tools for improving the physicochemical properties of the poorly water soluble drugs and their formulations.

complexation of piroxicam with cyclodextrins is a useful tool for enhancing the drug release from topical formulations.

cyclodextrins can be used in topical formulations as drug solubilizing excipients, which can improve drug permeation across the skin.
